summary: verdaccio-okta-oauth ships preinstall Bun-runtime dropper executing a 727KB obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (`setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<V>/...` and then invokes `execFileSync(bun, ['math_init.js'])` against a sibling file. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript blob (mangled identifiers such as `MmgoCP`, `etDiOOB`, `JqTtnbZ`; a rotated ~4000-entry string/constant array; a decoder function `hc1jfK9`; header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with no readable strings, comments, or source map. A Verdaccio auth plugin has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time to execute an opaque sibling script; the pattern executes attacker-controlled code on every installer's machine at `npm install` time and deliberately evades Node-scoped supply-chain scanners by running the payload under a freshly downloaded non-Node runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
